# Blackmoon 黑月

> Blackmoon (黑月) is a vinyl-only hi-fi listening bar on Beiluoguxiang (北锣鼓巷) in Beijing's Dongcheng hutongs. It shares one roof with Ravens (乌鸦, kitchen, est. 2017) and 古耳 Gǔ Ěr (specialty coffee). Records are hip-hop, soul/funk, jazz and City Pop. The venue hosts private events and buyouts, and provides off-site catering, cocktail and coffee bars, and meal boxes (盒饭).

## Visit

- Address: No. 66 Beiluoguxiang, Dongcheng District, Beijing / 北京市东城区北锣鼓巷 66 号
- Coffee (古耳): daily 10:00–18:00
- Bar: Tue–Thu 18:00–01:00 · Fri–Sat 18:00–01:30 · Sun 18:00–01:00 · closed Monday
- Table reservations: WeChat RavensDomain · phone +86 186 1174 1214
- Private hire, events, catering & meal boxes: WeChat ruhaox · 1994ep@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blackmoon.beijing/

## Private events (prices in RMB, service included, valid until 2027-03-31)

- Full venue buyout, 18:00–23:00 minimum spend on food & drinks: Tue–Thu ¥6,000 · Sun ¥8,000 · Fri–Sat ¥12,000 · peak dates from ¥15,000. Up to 40 seated.
- Semi-private area (12–20 guests): ¥3,000 · ¥4,000 · ¥5,000 · peak from ¥6,500.
- Daytime hire 10:00–17:00: Tue–Thu ¥500/h, Fri–Sun ¥700/h, minimum 3 hours.
- Per-guest packages (from 15 guests): Spin & Sip ¥198 · Ravens Supper ¥298 · Full Night ¥398.
- Off-peak: February and September, 20% off buyout minimums.
- Add-ons: selector vinyl DJ set ¥1,500 (3h) · bring your own DJ or band free · custom brand cocktail ¥800.
- Deposit 50%. Cancel 7+ days ahead for a full refund. Final headcount 72 hours before.
- Quiet hours: from 22:00 music stays below 80 dB; no loud voices outdoors.

## Catering & meal boxes

- Off-site catering: ¥98 / ¥168 / ¥238 per guest, min. 15 guests or ¥2,000, 5 days' notice, delivery within 5 km of Gulou.
- Meal boxes (盒饭): ¥68 / ¥98 / ¥138, min. 15 boxes, 2 days' notice; lunch 11:30–13:00 Tue–Fri, dinner 17:30–19:00.
- Mobile cocktail bar ¥1,500 (1 bartender, 3h, up to 50 guests) · 古耳 coffee bar ¥1,500 (3h, 50 cups).
